images.alt:
A tall, vertically composed fantasy painting centers a hooded, armored figure against a heavily textured background of ivory, taupe, charcoal, and rusty brown. The bowed hood is muted olive green, with a thin pale rim tracing its deep opening. Shadow conceals the eyes and upper face, leaving the nose, closed mouth, and chin visible. Layered green fabric crosses the shoulders and drapes diagonally over a dark metal breastplate decorated with a silver, featherlike emblem. Shaggy gray-brown fur frames the upper arms.
Large, loosely rendered pale wings spread behind the figure toward both upper corners, their feather forms dissolving into broad scraped strokes. An armored hand on the viewer’s left rests around the ornate hilt of a long sword. Its straight silver blade descends almost to the bottom edge. The other hand hangs near the right hip beside leather straps, metal fittings, and a second weapon hilt. Cream sleeves gather beneath intricate metal gauntlets.
The green cloak falls down the left side and pools across the foreground. Long ivory fabric hangs from the waist on the right, its folds merging with thick white paint and reddish vertical streaks. Rough canvas grain, scratches, drips, and layered brushwork soften the boundary between figure and background. Cursive lettering reading “Celestial Dominion” appears along the lower-right edge.
Keywords: hooded warrior, pale wings, olive cloak, ornate armor, longsword, metal gauntlets, ivory fabric, canvas texture, muted earth tones, fantasy portrait

images.alt:
A towering, ancient tree dominates a dark, mist-filled forest, its enormous, twisted trunk and sprawling roots forming a nearly impenetrable wall of weathered bark. Thick curtains of black, stringy moss and tangled vines descend from its massive branches, obscuring much of the tree's surface. At the base of the trunk, slightly right of center, an old wooden door stands partially open, revealing a narrow passage illuminated by a faint amber glow. A solitary woman with long, straight, pale blonde hair stands before the entrance, viewed from behind. She wears a muted gray-green dress, dark leggings, and tall boots, with one hand resting against the rough bark. Deep inside the shadowed doorway, a faint, pale humanoid figure appears to hover in the darkness. Immense roots twist across the damp forest floor, where shallow fog drifts between scattered leaves and exposed earth. Beyond the central tree, countless slender trunks disappear into cold, blue-gray woodland haze. The contrast between the tiny woman and the monumental tree emphasizes the overwhelming scale of the forest, while the concealed figure and mysterious doorway introduce an unsettling sense of discovery.
Keywords: ancient tree, dark forest, wooden doorway, blonde woman, hanging moss, twisted roots, shadow figure, forest mist, gothic fantasy, mysterious entrance, eerie woodland, amber light

images.alt:
A surreal, full-length fashion portrait features a slender young woman wearing an extravagant gown constructed entirely from vegetables, fruits, and leafy produce. She stands centrally against a softly lit, neutral gray-beige studio background, her head tilted gently to one side and both hands resting on her waist. An elaborate crown of pale green artichokes radiates around her head, framing loose, wavy brown hair and a delicate face.
Her fitted bodice and voluminous sleeves are fashioned from glossy, overlapping dark green leaves, with cascading vines of bright red and orange cherry tomatoes draped across her chest and waist. The enormous bell-shaped skirt expands outward in sculptural layers of cabbage, lettuce, and other leafy greens. A large, tightly curled cabbage resembles a pale green rose near the lower center, while overlapping slices of orange citrus fruit form a striking fan along the lower right. Additional tomatoes, shredded vegetables, and scattered produce spill across the floor around the gown's sweeping hem.
Warm directional studio lighting highlights the wet, waxy textures of the leaves, the translucent citrus slices, and the vivid contrast between earthy greens and brilliant reds. The composition combines theatrical haute couture with an extravagant edible still life.
Keywords:
vegetable couture, fruit fashion, artichoke crown, cabbage gown, cherry tomatoes, citrus slices, botanical fashion, avant-garde portrait, sculptural dress, edible textiles, surreal photography, harvest fashion

💗【メグ・モーラのハイレグアーマー】💗

「ねえモーラ、このモーラのハイレグアーマーを着て買い物してきたら、ボクに美味しいものくれるって本当？」

モーラのハイレグアーマーを着て、買い物に行かさそうなメグ。

「本当っしょ！モーラ装備を流行らせるっしょ！」

ところが、メグは衣装をくんくん。

「くんくん、モーラ、これ洗ってる？ モーラの濃い匂いがすっごいよ。ボク、くらくらしちゃうよ」

「えっ！？ちょ、メグ！失礼っしょ！」

「もうダメ！ボク、なんか変な気持ちになってきちゃった♡」

#AIイラスト #AIArt #競泳水着 #ハイレグ #ハイレグアーマー

💜【カラーズ・ゴウ】💜

「殿、今夜は私が警護します♡」

極悪転生者集団カラーズの有力者、紫鎧の男。

紫鎧の男は歴史オタクで、戦国時代の「赤備え」を模した「紫備え」という私兵集団を持っています。

その紫備えのくノ一部隊長、ゴウ。

レベル100のニンジャマスターで、短剣二刀流の使い手です。

歴史にも詳しく、明るく社交的で、冗談が好き。

紫鎧の男を「殿」と呼び、忠誠心は誰にも負けません。

「殿、今夜は片時もおそばを離れませんよ、殿♪」

今宵の護衛は、どうやら気合十分のようです！

#AIイラスト #AIArt #ダークファンタジー #マイクロビキニ #ビキニ

【トモエ・ボディコン】

「何じゃこのピチピチの服は！しかも、騒がしくて珍妙な音楽は一体何なのじゃ！」

今夜の夢は、鮮やかなボディコン姿のトモエ。

突如流れ始めたユーロビートに、トモエの体が勝手に動き出す!?

「この踊りは……は、激しいのう！」

戸惑いながらも、激しい音楽に合わせてパラパラを踊るトモエ。

「でも、何だか楽しいわい！」

「主人殿の夢には、毎晩驚かされるのう。実は、妾は最近、主人殿に夢で会うのを楽しみにしておるのじゃ」

今夜も夢の中で、新しい文化に出会ってしまったようです。
